intent: A vast frozen crater lake fills the highland, its pale ice drowned in black pines and cut by heaved ridges and black leads, with the road crossing the wood to a runestone ring beneath a broken crown of ice teeth.
requests: A cell kind that paints its own ground without counting as heath for the tileset's ground-mist budget: a lake-sized sheet of ice has to be road-kind floor today to stay inside the phone budget.
A cell-look option for broken or sloped tops on lifted wall cells; a forest of spires built from square lifted cells reads as flat-topped slabs up close.
